title: AC1021 paper-space classification from validated BLOCK_RECORD ownership
scope: Correct the entity space flag after typed DWG parsing and successful block-owner validation, using the active containing BLOCK_RECORD name for model/paper-space records.

implementation.rule: For an ordinary typed entity in the current validated block scope, derive DRW::PaperSpace from *PAPER_SPACE or *PAPER_SPACE<n>, and DRW::ModelSpace from *MODEL_SPACE. Do not change named-block entities or entities whose owner does not match the current scope. Once a validated INSERT/POLYLINE aggregate is ready, propagate its space to its ATTRIB/VERTEX children before delivery.
implementation.generatedControl: libdxfrw_entity_space_from_block_record checks canonical model/paper names, numbered layouts, an ownerless legacy walk, mismatched ownership, ordinary named blocks, direct VERTEX exclusion, INSERT-to-ATTRIB and POLYLINE-to-VERTEX inheritance, and supported-pair boundaries.

autodeskCommonEntityCodes.finding: Group 330 identifies the owning BLOCK_RECORD; group 67 defaults to model space when omitted or zero and is one for paper space.

autodeskBlockDefinitions.finding: Paper-space layout definitions use *Paper_Space, *Paper_Space0, *Paper_Space1, and subsequent numbered names; group 67 distinguishes paper-space entities.

odaSpecification.finding: ODA specifies the common entity entmode field and the common owner-handle data; the reviewed text does not itself state the DXF group-67 mapping for every numbered layout owner.

libreDwgPeer.finding: LibreDWG derives DXF paper space for entmode 1 or entmode 0 with the header paper-space BLOCK_RECORD owner. Its 0.14 DXF conversion of the same local samples omits group 67 for some numbered paper-space owners, while emitting group 67=1 for other paper-space viewports. This peer output is conflicting implementation evidence and is not treated as normative semantic proof.
